bug_semantics: NextChat's dedicated WebDAV proxy catch-all at app/api/webdav/[...path]/route.ts concatenates unsanitized catch-all path segments (params.path.join) onto a caller-supplied WebDAV endpoint and then only suffix-checks the resulting URL (endsWith STORAGE_KEY or STORAGE_KEY/backup.json). It never canonicalizes the joined path, never rejects encoded or literal '..' / '.' segments, and never verifies that the resolved path remains under the intended backup folder. A crafted GET/PUT to /api/webdav/%2E%2E/... (or equivalent dot segments) therefore traverses out of the backup.json/folder allowlist and can read or write other resources on an allowlisted WebDAV host via authenticated or anonymous proxying. Endpoint-hostname allowlisting added later addresses SSRF host choice, not this path-segment traversal.
flaw_origin: 038fa3b301794050ec7e59325aa00f25b3ce3257 first created app/api/webdav/[...path]/route.ts. That introduction already joined unsanitized catch-all segments into the upstream URL and enforced access only with endsWith(folder)/endsWith(fileName) checks. The parent tree 9a8497299d11706f096a4fc10ff0ab5af43465c7 has no app/api/webdav/ tree; earlier WebDAV support (6f83fbd21278c90cd978108abe54291c38ec10d7) only added a client helper plus a generic CORS proxy. Later commits (99aa0643 joining the full params.path, suffix-check refactors, 9fb8fbcc endpoint-host allowlisting) preserved the unsanitized join. HEAD still has the same join-and-suffix-check pattern and no '..' rejection.
ai_marker: absent; BIC author/committer Fred <fred@nextchat.dev>; no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or bot trailers on the commit object
evidence: Advisory GHSA-6p2w-vm5p-8648 / CVE-2025-50735: WebDAV proxy catch-all fails to canonicalize or reject dot path segments; NVD/GHSA not withdrawn. Researcher write-up (github.com/fai1424/Vulnerability-Research/CVE-2025-50735) and PoC (hackmd.io/@fai1424/S1QvgAo0gl) describe crafted GET/PUT to /api/webdav/%2E%2E/...; researcher stated unfixed as of 2025-11-02. First-party file: app/api/webdav/[...path]/route.ts. git log --diff-filter=A -- app/api/webdav/[...path]/route.ts => 038fa3b301794050ec7e59325aa00f25b3ce3257 ('fix: add webdav request filter', Fred <fred@nextchat.dev>, 2024-03-14). git cat-file -p 038fa3b3: single parent 9a8497299d11706f096a4fc10ff0ab5af43465c7; not a merge. git cat-file -e 9a849729:app/api/webdav/[...path]/route.ts fails (file absent at parent); git ls-tree parent has app/utils/cloud/webdav.ts and app/api/cors/[...path]/route.ts only. Introducer already does endpointPath = subpath.join('/') then endsWith(folder)/endsWith(fileName) with no canonicalize/reject. git merge-base --is-ancestor 038fa3b3 v2.16.0/v2.16.1/HEAD: yes; first containing tag v2.11.3. Later 99aa0643 changes join to params.path.join('/') but keeps unsanitized join; 9fb8fbcc adds endpoint-host allowlisting (SSRF), not path canonicalize. git log v2.16.0..HEAD -- app/api/webdav empty. HEAD route.ts still has params.path.join('/') + targetPath suffix checks; rg finds no '..'/canonical/reject. git cat-file -p 038fa3b3: author/committer Fred <fred@nextchat.dev>; body empty; no Co-Authored-By/Generated-with/bot trailers. Unpatched through HEAD defdcdb55d850cd12c4c657eb83729fd66e215c0 (2026-08-11). ppa re-checked line-level 2026-08-29: git show 038fa3b3 -- 'app/api/webdav/[...path]/route.ts' says 'new file mode 100644' and git ls-tree -r 9a849729 lists only app/utils/cloud/webdav.ts under webdav paths, so the vulnerable route (params.path.join('/') interpolated into the proxy target) does not exist at the parent. -> introducer_parent_absent=true.
reasoning: The vulnerability is CWE-22 in the dedicated WebDAV catch-all proxy: unsanitized catch-all segments are joined onto the upstream URL and gated only by suffix equality, so encoded/literal '..' escapes the backup.json allowlist. The smallest public first-write of that route is 038fa3b3; the immediate parent lacks the file entirely, so this is not a move/refactor/squash. Pre-existing WebDAV client code (6f83fbd2) did not introduce this server catch-all. The flawed join-and-suffix-check mechanism is present at introduction and remains on HEAD after v2.16.0/v2.16.1, matching the advisory's unpatched thru-2.16.0 claim. AI is judged only from the BIC commit object: human author/committer Fred, empty body, no AI/bot trailers, so NOT_AI. No fix SHA exists because no later commit canonicalizes or rejects dot segments; remaining_gap records the unpatched state.
